pages.title: Pygmy Hippopotamus
pages.text: The pygmy hippopotamus ($(o)Choeropsis liberiensis$()) lives in the rainforest swamps and streams of West Africa, mostly in Liberia.$(br2)It weighs less than a fifth as much as a common hippo, with longer legs, a small rounded head with eyes on the sides, and greenish-black skin that fades to creamy grey below.$(br2)Shy and solitary, it hides in swamps by day and comes out at night to eat ferns, leaves and fruit.
